scientific_limitations: The theorem is for iid Haar-uniform sites on a torus and a positive Matérn-type periodic Fourier spectrum.
It concerns frequency-cube Fourier truncation and squared Frobenius Gram-matrix error, not nonperiodic Fourier-grid aliasing or posterior prediction.
The finite-sample probability bound is polynomial (Chebyshev); exponential concentration is not established.
The publication-priority comparison is not independently audited.
title: A sharp sample-size crossover for Fourier-truncated periodic Matérn covariance matrices
